title: Recheck named-root identity after a definitive source-capture refusal
outcome: A definitive source refusal belongs to the named root actually measured. If the named path or repository changes during the off-lock capture, leave it as transient absence instead of installing another tree's permanent refusal.
acceptance: A deterministically ordered named-path or repository swap during a refused capture returns transient absence and retains the bounded retry behavior; unchanged-root refusal still preserves its definitive reason.
The post-refusal check enforces canonical named-root identity and the expected repository common-directory key, without weakening existing success checks or source/credit authority.
Focused regressions cover the changed capture path and existing definitive and transient controls; the exact final input is reviewed and passes the required gate.
